description: This Java test source file contains unit tests for the Sending class within the messaging service component of the Eclipse Ditto project. It verifies behaviors such as acknowledgements, monitor updates, exception handling, and responses for message sending scenarios.

classes.name: SendingTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the Sending component, testing message acknowledgement, monitor updates, exception handling, and response mechanisms.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mocks and test data before each test method.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullSendingContext
methods.description: Tests constructor of Sending with null sending context, expecting null pointer exception.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullFuture
methods.description: Tests constructor of Sending with null future, expecting null pointer exception.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullLogger
methods.description: Tests constructor of Sending with null logger, expecting null pointer exception.

methods.name: acknowledgeAndMonitorNullCommandResponseWhenShouldAcknowledge
methods.description: Verifies behavior when a command response is null, but acknowledgement is expected; checks monitor failure calls.

methods.name: monitorAcknowledgementSendSuccessKeepOriginalResponse
methods.description: Validates that successful acknowledgement monitoring keeps the original response intact.

methods.name: monitorAcknowledgementSendFailureKeepOriginalResponse
methods.description: Verifies that failed acknowledgement monitoring handles negative acknowledgment appropriately.

methods.name: monitorLiveResponseSendSuccessKeepOriginalResponse
methods.description: Checks that live response success updates the monitor and retains the original response.

methods.name: monitorLiveResponseSendFailureKeepOriginalResponse
methods.description: Tests handling of failure in live response acknowledgement, ensuring correct exception handling.

methods.name: monitorNothingAsShouldNotAcknowledgeAndOriginalResponseIsNull
methods.description: Ensures that when no response is present, monitors are not called and the result is null.

methods.name: monitorAndAcknowledgeWhenFutureResponseTerminatedExceptionallyAndNoAckLabelIssued
methods.description: Validates that exceptions during future response completion are handled correctly when no acknowledgement label is issued.
